title: Breaking: David Jones creditors owed almost half a billion dollars
paragraphs: It's been revealed that David Jones is deeply in debt, with its liabilities tallied so far reaching almost half a billion dollars.
The retailer owes at least $180 million to suppliers, more than $200 million to lenders and more than $10 million to its own staff.
The debts are being revealed right now at the first creditors' meeting for the embattled department store, which was placed into voluntary administration earlier this month.
